input.free_text_description: The system operates in the scheduling, file management domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer, System, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include abstract redis, compileflow, compileflow. Core business data revolves around ParallelAccountInfo, ReceiveMessageEntity, SmsReportMessageListener.

As a API Consumer, I want to manage abstract redis operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
